role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 宙斯面前所有人都无处遁形，他召唤的一道惊雷会让周围的英雄暴露无遗，放出的弧形闪电可以游遍附近的敌人，而号令的可怕霹雳将打击一切仇敌。无论敌人何在，宙斯都将找到他们。
hero_summary_en: None can hide from Zeus, whether he's calling down a bolt to reveal the surroundings, sending an arc coursing through his nearest enemies, or summoning a terrifying volley of lightning upon all enemies. Wherever his foes are, Zeus will find them.

abilities.name: zuus_arc_lightning
abilities.description_zh: 释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

abilities.name: zuus_lightning_bolt
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂眩晕。施放后，雷击在目标周围%sight_radius_night%范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于%spread_aoe%范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
abilities.description_en: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
notes_zh: 该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。
notes_en: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

abilities.name: zuus_heavenly_jump
abilities.description_zh: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近%vision_radius%范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。
abilities.description_en: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: zuus_cloud
abilities.description_zh: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。
abilities.description_en: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得%cloud_bounty_tooltip%金。
以宙斯当前等级的雷击作用于最近的敌方单位。
防御塔和非英雄单位对雷云造成半额伤害。
notes_en: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.

abilities.name: zuus_lightning_hands
abilities.description_zh: 宙斯获得攻击速度加成，并且他的攻击会产生弧形闪电，造成一定百分比的伤害。可以关闭，使攻击不附带该效果。
abilities.description_en: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

abilities.name: zuus_thundergods_wrath
abilities.description_zh: 用闪电打击所有敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害，无论他们身在何处。在打击前提供每个英雄的真实视域。
abilities.description_en: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
facet_text_en: Damage is dealt to one enemy at a time, moving from lowest health hero to highest. If an enemy is killed by this ability, the damage for all subsequent enemies is increased.
facet_text_zh: 从最低生命值的英雄开始，逐一对敌人造成伤害，最后是生命值最高的敌人。如果有敌人被这个技能击杀，那么接下来所有敌人受到的伤害都会增加。

abilities.name: zuus_static_field
abilities.description_zh: 宙斯攻击或通过技能击中敌人都会电击他们，造成他们当前生命值一定百分比的伤害。
abilities.description_en: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
facet_text_en: Static Field deals more damage to nearby enemies.
facet_text_zh: 静电场对附近的敌人造成更多伤害。
